```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))
patrimoine <- tribble(
  ~source, ~dataset,
  "bdf",  "CFT",
  "insee",  "T_8201",
  "insee",  "T_82XX") %>%
  arrange(source, dataset)
```
